thread:
maria: FYI onboarding partner 'Neptune' failing SCIM create for ~20 users. Saw role attribute missing. Starting thread to coordinate.
aj: When did this start? any deploys around that time?
kevin: Hit this today around 10:12 UTC. We got a bunch of 400s from /scim/v2/Users create. Logs show 'missing required attribute: role'
lina: Did IdP change mappings? Neptune claimed they only changed a SAML template recently.
provisioner-bot: [10:12:34] scim.create failed user=neptune/ops-2304 error=MissingAttribute(role) request_id=req_84d3
kevin: I pulled a raw SAML assertion from a repro -- looks like the Role attribute exists but the XML namespace prefix changed from 'saml:' to 's:'. Example snippet: ``<s:Attribute Name="urn:redwood:attr:role"> <s:AttributeValue>engineer</s:AttributeValue></s:Attribute>``
maria: our SCIM mapping only matches attribute with namespace http://www.oasis-open.org... under saml: prefix? That seems brittle.
aj: We should never rely on prefix. The parser should resolve by namespace URI. Is our assertion parser ignoring namespace URIs?
dmitri: I grep'd the parser code: xmlutil.getLocalName(...) used correctly, but there is a pre-processing step that strips namespaces when validating against schema. There's a regex that expects localname 'Attribute' with no prefix but then checks attribute Name starts with 'urn:redwood:attr:'. Hm.
kevin: More weirdness: for some Neptune users the SCIM payload also had ext_id encrypted with our KMS envelope. We then got a decrypt failure for a few create attempts: ``KMS: decrypt failed: invalid envelope header``. It looks intermittent.
lina: Could be two independent issues: (1) SAML namespace prefix change causing role not mapped -> SCIM create missing role; (2) KMS envelope from Neptune side is using a different CMK/format. Are both affecting same users?
maria: Cross-checking user list: 17 failed w/ missing role, 3 failed w/ KMS decrypt. Overlap for 1 user who had both.
aj: Immediate mitigation: can we fall back to mapping on AttributeName without namespace for onboarding while we patch? Toggle in staging first.
dmitri: I can flip a feature flag that allows namespace-agnostic matching for the next 2 hours. Quick command: ``/ops feature-toggle scim.ns_flexible on --expires 2h``
sre-ops: Heads up: enabling that will broaden matching, but should be low risk during off-hours. I'll watch infra metrics.
kevin: For the KMS decrypt error, what does the payload look like? Any chance Neptune wrapped with their KMS envelope format (not our expected envelope)?
maria: Attached blob (redacted) shows header: ``{"alg":"AEADv1","enc":"aws-kms-envelope","keyid":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/XXX"}`` vs ours which is ``{"alg":"redwood-kms-v1","cmk":"projects/..."}``
aj: If partner sends our expected envelope, we decrypt; otherwise we should return 400 with clear error explaining expected envelope. For now we can add better auditing and a clear error message.
lina: I've drafted a notification to Neptune: "we saw SAML attribute namespace change causing role mapping failures; also some encryptions are not in our expected KMS envelope format. Please confirm change logs." Sending now.
provisioner-bot: [10:34:02] scim.audit event=USER_CREATE_FAILURE reason=MissingAttribute(role) sample_request=req_84d3
kevin: Postmortem-level things: add test asserting we accept Attribute elements by namespace URI not prefix; add an ingest validator that rejects unknown KMS envelope headers with an actionable error.
dmitri: I'll open a jira: SEC-1421 for parser fix + regression tests. Lina can you include sample Neptune assertions?
lina: Yep attaching sample SAML XML in the ticket.
sre-ops: Monitoring: after toggling ns_flexible on, I see failed creates drop from 17->1 over 15 minutes. KMS decrypt failures unchanged.
maria: Good. For the one remaining missing-role user, logs show malformed AttributeValue (empty). I'll reach out to Neptune for a resend.
aj: For KMS issue, ask Neptune to rewrap ext_id with our documented envelope (link to docs) or provide wrapped key we can accept. Also add audit log entry for any decrypt failures so SOC can correlate.
kevin: Action item list: (1) dmitri: parser fix + tests (SEC-1421); (2) ops/dmitri: add clear 400 on unknown envelope + audit log (SEC-1422); (3) lina: coordinate with Neptune and request re-provision for 4 users and sample assertions; (4) maria: follow up on the malformed value.
dmitri: I'll estimate ~4 dev days for parser + tests, ~1 day for the validator. I'll set up canary on staging.
lina: Neptune replied: they rolled a transform to re-prefix namespaces for a templating lib upgrade — they pushed a patch and will resend. They also confirmed they can rewrap ext_id using our envelope.
maria: OK let's keep ns_flexible on until parser fix lands in staging + we've verified Neptune resends. Once fixed, we'll revert the flag and deploy.
sre-ops: Flag will be auto-reverted at +2h unless we extend. If we need longer, say now.
kevin: Extend to +12h while we validate incoming resends.
sre-ops: Done.
provisioner-bot: [11:06:29] scim.create succeeded user=neptune/ops-2305 request_id=req_859a note=wrapped_ok
maria: Closing loop: Neptune resent payloads, KMS envelope fixed, parser PR opened by dmitri (link to PR). Will triage postmortem next week with action items. Thanks all :thumbsup:
